name: Meadow Buddies
blurb: A gentle, gamified fitness companion: sage landscapes, apricot activity cards, cocoa controls, rounded white sheets and hand-drawn woodland buddies.

tagline.zh: 鼠尾草绿与杏黄，森林伙伴陪你运动

origin.note: Original HTML, CSS and inline SVG reconstruction from a user-provided three-screen fitness UI reference. Reference creator and source URL were not supplied. The reference image is not redistributed; MIT covers the authored implementation only.
